sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the evidence, operand, result, owner, datatype, unit, midpoint-formula, and corrected maximum-selection semantics. Replace the midpoint SPARQL query's ?c1,?c2,?c3,?c4 permutation/cross-product with one bounded calculation query using the four required case nodes and explicit case-local midpoint pairings; it must violate when coverage is missing, duplicated, or outside LBOW/8, 3*LBOW/8, 5*LBOW/8, and 7*LBOW/8 within tolerance. Also remove the combinatorial four-case cross-product from the maxima query, using SHACL Core cardinalities plus a bounded query so F, Q, and P maxima are checked without arbitrary case permutations.
